usage: 緊張 (gan2 zoeng1) is used to describe a feeling of nervousness or tension.
It commonly describes a temporary emotional state before or during stressful situations.
You can use it to describe yourself or others who feel uneasy or anxious.
Its basic structure is subject + 緊張, e.g., 我緊張 (I'm nervous).
It can be combined with other expressions to show specific causes of nervousness.
